links.note: test/fixtures/ holds deliberately broken plans and fake repos; their links are data, not docs.

typecheck-tests.note: tsconfig.json is the published build and covers src/ only, so test/ would otherwise never be type-checked.

rule-tests.note: Every content rule in rules/ has a fixture in rule-tests/. Location rules are covered by test/integration/layout-rules.test.ts.

keyframes.description: This repo's own keyframes.md, checked strictly
keyframes.note: bin/keyframes.js runs the CLI from dist/, which the types slot's tsc --build writes, so this check goes last, after that wave's barrier.
